name: clean-bubbles
provenance: Authored by hand by the Test Developer (claude-opus-5) for MT-007 RED on 2026-09-15. Wholly synthetic: no pixel of it comes from a scan, so it is redistributable (MT-007 C-9).
purpose: AC-1 and AC-4. Three well-separated blobs, each covered by an accepted box of EXACTLY the blob's rectangle, so that the fence of C-4 step 7 clips the dilation straight back and every mask is pixel-exact at any dilation setting.

paint.note: right half of B1: makes the MEAN over B1 exactly 0.8 while the MAX is exactly 1.0, so C-7's mean-not-max is observable

notes: Areas: B1 60x50 = 3000, B2 80x50 = 4000, B3 80x60 = 4800. All three are far above any plausible MIN_REGION_AREA_PX.

Emission order by (bbox y0, bbox x0) is B2 (y=30), B1 (y=40), B3 (y=150) - which is neither the order the boxes are listed in nor left-to-right, so the ordering rule is observable rather than accidental.
B1 and B2 are 80px apart and B3 is 60px below B1, so 2 iterations of a 7x7 kernel (6px) could not merge them even with the fence removed.
cls 1 = bubble, cls 0 = box - measured in MT-007 RED, see the story's amendment A-4.
